programme.title: Ip Man (2025)
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster (2024)
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that’s grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re back with Double T Outfitters for this episode of Storytellers, filmed at the beautiful Las Lagunas Ranch in South Texas! - This hunt was one to remember as we spent time with the Price family, including Logan—our Show Your Skull Showdown winner from last season! From unforgettable hunts and incredible wildlife to evenings around hunting camp with amazing people, this trip was filled with memories that will last a lifetime. A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. This episode is packed with great hunting, genuine friendships, and the stories that make the outdoors so special.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: The Storyteller
programme.desc: A barren peasant woman, desperately craving a child, naively says aloud that she wouldn't care what it looks like. Soon enough, she gives birth to a baby who resembles a hedgehog, much to the father's dismay and the scorn of the villagers.

programme.title: The Storyteller: Greek Myths
programme.desc: Owing to the Oracle's prophesy, Perseus is born in darkness and captivity. Together with his mother Danaë, the young son of Zeus manages to escape death at sea. After coming of age, the young hero vows to bring back back Medusa the Gorgon to stop the evil king Polydektes from marrying his mother. He is given special weapons and armor by the gods to complete his task but still cannot escape the prophesy that he will one day kill his grandfather.

programme.title: The Aware Show

programme.title: The Aware Show

programme.title: The Aware Show

His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

programme.title: The Aware Show

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Mom Didn't Fight for Me
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Husband Doesn't Want Me as a Business Partner
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: I Don't Trust I'll Find Someone to Create a Life With
programme.desc: Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: Relationships and Your Spiritual Journey
programme.desc: Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: How to Have Miraculous Relationships
programme.desc: A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: Relationships Are Opportunities for Growth
programme.desc: The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: To truly grasp the concept of forgiveness, we have to be willing to see past the person's mistakes. The benefit we get from being more forgiving isn't that other people are going to be more forgiving towards us, it's that it won't affect us when they aren't.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In this lesson, we'll discover the significance of holy relationships. After all, souls are brought together for the purpose of enlightenment.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Varios compradores en Colombia enfrentan el incumplimiento de Constructores que no entregan sus viviendas. Tras años de espera, demandan por estafa y negligencia, mientras los proyectos siguen paralizados o en problemas legales.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Rubén Andrade desapareció el 12 de abril de 2020 en Bosa. Su cuerpo fue hallado 4 días después en Soacha. Su ex, Yendi Paola, confesó haberlo envenenado y apuñalado, luego arrojó el cuerpo al río con ayuda de un taxista.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Bryan Steven Rivera, un niño de 7 años, desapareció en la zona cafetera de Colombia; una testigo relató que un hombre lo atrajo con dulces. La investigación llevó a un retrato hablado de "El Peruano", identificado como Carlos Alberto Gómez Loaiza, con antecedentes por abuso sexual violento. Reconocido por testigos, fue detenido en Pereira para responder por la desaparición del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Ángela Carolina fue hallada muerta en Villa Rica, Tolima. John Fredy, movido por odio hacia su esposa infiel, confesó el crimen y fue condenado a 36 años por el asesinato de Carolina y su esposa. Luego intentó cambiar su versión, sin éxito.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Cindy Piña fue asesinada por su ex Edinson Dussán en abril de 2020 en Neiva, tras visitarlo para ver a sus hijos. Estaba embarazada de su nueva pareja. Él la enterró en el patio y confesó.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Dos mujeres en Popayán, toman la decisión equivocada de invitar dos hombres a su casa para tomarse unos tragos, estos se drogan, se emborrachan y deciden que van a matarlas, en seguida los hombres huyen creyendo que habían asesinado a las dos mujeres, con lo que no contaban los atacantes, era que una de las víctimas sobreviviera y fuera testigo de los hechos.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Cuatro policías colombianos se infiltraron en África occidental, haciéndose pasar por turistas, profesores y médicos, para rescatar a la hermana Gloria Narváez, secuestrada por Al Qaeda en Malí durante cuatro años. El Coronel Gustavo Camargo lideró esta misión casi suicida, negociando en las entrañas del grupo terrorista. Tras años de estrategia y paciencia, la monja fue liberada sin disparos ni violencia.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: En 2021, miles de migrantes haitianos, venezolanos y cubanos cruzaron el peligroso Tapón del Darién hacia Estados Unidos. Los Informantes siguió a Mikabens Meneus y su familia, quienes tras varados un mes en Necoclí, pagaron miles de dólares para atravesar la selva, enfrentando coyotes, pandillas y condiciones infrahumanas en busca del sueño americano.

programme.desc: ¡Brittany cree que Dionte es el padre de su bebé y lo demostrará! Después, Melissa, de 24 años, afirma que Rob, de 47 años, es el padre de su bebé, ¡pero la hija de Rob quiere pruebas! Además, ¿el padre del bebé de Crystal es su ex, el primo de su ex, o su marido?

programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

programme.title: Public Cowboy, No. 1 (1937)
programme.desc: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

programme.title: Under Western Stars (1938)
programme.desc: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail (1948)
programme.desc: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

programme.title: Colorado (1940)
programme.desc: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer (1957)
programme.desc: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).

programme.title: Rawhide (1938)
programme.desc: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

programme.title: Yellowneck (1955)
programme.desc: A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan (1934)
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

programme.title: Wagon Trail (1935)
programme.desc: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks (1961)
programme.desc: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions (1962)
programme.desc: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

programme.title: The Last of the Clintons (1935)
programme.desc: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

programme.desc: El policía tribal navajo Joe Leaphorn investiga la muerte de un hombre involucrado en una misteriosa secta, mientras Jim Chee, pluriempleado como detective privado, trabaja en su propio caso.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn profundiza en los vínculos personales que lo unen a un caso cada vez más enigmático. El sargento Manuelito interroga a Chee, aunque se muestra reticente a hacerlo. El hallazgo de un cadáver provoca que Leaphorn y Manuelito busquen a un niño.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Chee empieza a actuar por su propia cuenta tras el encuentro con un hombre peligroso. Leaphorn y Manuelito establecen una alianza con el sheriff del departamento, lo que le permite a Leaphorn encontrar una pista muy importante.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn pone en peligro su vida durante la persecución de un sospechoso. Manuelito desafía al sheriff con la intención de rescatar a su jefe. Chee reflexiona sobre una propuesta peligrosa que le ofrecerá respuestas sobre el caso.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn trabaja a contrarreloj para obtener una confesión de un sospechoso antes de que deje de estar bajo su custodia. Mientras tanto, Chee se introduce de incógnito en la secta que vincula sus distintas investigaciones.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn y Chee encuentran evidencias que vinculan sus casos, pero traen consigo una amarga verdad: será difícil que se haga justicia. Entretanto, Manuelito se prepara para un gran cambio en su vida.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn y Chee buscan a un testigo tras el hallazgo de la bicicleta de un adolescente desaparecido. En la frontera, Manuelito encuentra a una madre y a su hijo conmocionados.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn y Chee se encuentran en una cacería humana después de hacer un descubrimiento impactante. El agente especial Washington interroga a Leaphorn sobre una persona de interés.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Tras vivir una situación peligrosa, Leaphorn y Chee siguen el rastro de un nuevo sospechoso. El descubrimiento de un cadáver envía a la agente especial Washington en una dirección diferente.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: El policía tribal navajo Joe Leaphorn debe resolver crímenes junto a su nuevo ayudante, Jim Chee, que vuelve a la reserva por primera vez desde que era niño. Ellos se enfrentarán a fuerzas malignas, terrenales y sobrenaturales.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn y Chee entrevistan al testigo superviviente de los asesinatos del motel Big Rock. Chee se reúne con el forense. La causa de la muerte sigue siendo un misterio. Manuelito realiza un descubrimiento escalofriante.

programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Andrew Jones' Super Jeep
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.sub-title: US Open 2024 – Women’s Split Pro Doubles Semifinal – Courter & Humberg vs Frantova & Karges
programme.desc: Sheri Courter and Mari Humberg take on Martina Frantova and Christine Karges in this Women’s Split Pro Doubles Semifinal match at the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships. With fast-paced exchanges, sharp angles, and tactical precision, both teams battle for a spot in the finals on the prestigious Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida. This high-stakes match features standout teamwork and thrilling rallies from some of the sport’s most skilled competitors.

programme.title: NPL
programme.sub-title: NPL 2024 – Mixed Team Match – Drivers vs Ignite
programme.desc: The National Pickleball League heats up as the Indianapolis Drivers take on the Austin Ignite in a coed team match packed with intensity, teamwork, and standout rallies. Representing two competitive NPL franchises, this mixed showdown brings high-level play, strategic depth, and crowd-fueled energy to the court. Whether you're cheering for the Drivers or backing the Ignite, this match is a showcase of what makes NPL team pickleball exciting to watch.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.sub-title: US Open 2023 – Mixed Sr Pro Doubles Gold – Bellamy & Witsken vs Welsher & Merchant
programme.desc: The stakes are sky-high in this Mixed Senior Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships. Beth Bellamy and Rick Witsken team up with power and precision as they face off against the dynamic duo of Eva Welsher and Altaf Merchant. With each rally more intense than the last, the match showcases expert-level shot placement, quick hands at the kitchen, and the emotional highs and lows of championship pickleball.From thrilling volleys to strategic momentum shifts, this final clash is a must-watch for fans of senior pro competition. Watch as tempers flare, crowds roar, and legends battle for the ultimate title in Naples, Florida.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.sub-title: Troubadour Club 2024 – Exhibition Match – Johnson & East vs Kennedy & Burrows
programme.desc: Set at the scenic Troubadour Golf and Field Club in Nashville, TN, this exhibition match brings a mix of celebrity flair and friendly competition to the pickleball court. Olympian Shawn Johnson and her husband Andrew East take on TV host Jason Kennedy and pro Wes Burrows in a lighthearted yet tightly contested match that goes down to the wire. With Shawn still learning the ropes (and the rules), and Andrew channeling his athletic instincts, the duo puts up an impressive fight against the more experienced Kennedy and Burrows. It’s a fast-paced, fun-filled match full of laughs, learning moments, and great rallies—perfect for fans of lifestyle sports and celebrity matchups.

programme.sub-title: Rockwall Regional Pool Play Match - Arkansas vs. UT Dallas
programme.desc: Experience the intensity of collegiate pickleball as the University of Arkansas "Hogs" face off against UT Dallas in a high-stakes pool play matchup at the NCPA 2025 Dallas Regional. This "best-of-seven" format showcases the full spectrum of the sport, including gender doubles, singles, and mixed doubles, with teams competing for a prize pool and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis.The match features elite collegiate talent, including Arkansas’ Alison Lee and Yasmine Humbert, who bring high-energy play and powerful forehands to the court. programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Boxeador desmemoriado; Ciudadanía en cuestión por droga
programme.desc: Antonella pide ayuda psicológica para su esposo, su trabajo lo convirtió en un hombre violento. Luisa se casa con Javier, él le ofrece los papeles, pero oculta su pasado como narcotraficante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ébola mortal; Ley en California: Sí significa sí
programme.desc: Miller quiere anular su matrimonio con José, tiene ébola y lo ocultó, además vende su sangre infectada. Luis demanda a su exnovia, ella le complicó la vida al acusarlo de forzarla a tener sexo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: "Depredador" en Halloween; Adopta, mi hijo no
programme.desc: Angélica descubre que su esposo y padre de su niña es un depredador sexual, pide el divorcio. Antonio pierde a su hijo cuando la madre desaparece, ahora le exige a su ex cuñada que lo devuelva.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La muñeca mujer maravilla; Olor a pescado
programme.desc: Sueña con someterse a una cirugía plástica que le permita lucir igual que una muñeca. Florencia es joven, bella y de buen corazón, pero no es feliz; su cuerpo despide un olor nauseabundo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mucho selfie, poco sexo; Estoy en el certificado, es mío
programme.desc: Mariana está enganchada a los selfies, su esposo la demanda, por su vicio, ya no tienen sexo. Tatiana pide la custodia de su sobrino, la madre está presa y su excuñado no es el padre biológico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Profesor golpeado; Novia de ella y amante de la momia
programme.desc: Roberto es profesor y demanda a la madre de su novia, cuando ella descubrió la relación le dio una paliza. Victoria le exige a la amante de su marido que devuelva los bienes que él le entregó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jean quiere abortar, grabar el procedimiento y comercializar el video. Sofia, su ex, se opone. Killer acaba de salir de prisión y le exige a Fabiana, su excuñada, que le devuelva a sus gemelas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Fotos del miembro; Viudo esquizofrénico con custodia
programme.desc: Catalina recibe fotos donde su jefe le muestra el miembro, ella lo denuncia y él la demanda. Además, Yassiri exige la custodia de las hijas de Jonathan, él es esquizofrénico y puede ser peligroso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Basta de indocumentados; Abuelo se pone vestido
programme.desc: Mayra exige que su actual pareja le devuelva el dinero que le entregó porque necesita ayudar a su hijo. Rosa pide la custodia de su padre, su sobrina usa al abuelo para promocionar sus diseños.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Renuncia en TV por marihuana; Padrastro no quiere niña, ella sí
programme.desc: Martín, dueño de un canal online, demanda a Ivana porque usó la plataforma para vender drogas. Karina le pide a su ex que no abandone a su niña —no es su hija biológica—, pero ella no lo sabe.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No quiero a mi prostituta madre; Niña de 14 quiere su hijo
programme.desc: Nazarena le exige a su marido que desaloje a la mujer que la abandonó a los tres años, su madre biológica. Jessica tiene 14 años y un bebé; los abuelos paternos le piden que entregue al niño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: 17 años con cáncer pide divorcio de padres; Casi viuda 51 expresivamente sexual
programme.desc: Celimar tiene 17 años y para sobrellevar su enfermedad en paz quiere que sus padres se separen. María se dedica a vivir la vida loca con el dinero de su esposo, desde que este cayó en coma.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Suegra con Guillain Barre Syndrome; Sin vagina nací
programme.desc: Lorena demanda a su marido, él tiene sexo con su suegra enferma, según dice, para ayudarla. Lorena nació sin vagina, por eso quiere usar el dinero que ha ahorrado con su esposo para operarse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ángel demanda a Estela, la madre de su hija de 12 años, y le exige que reconozca su paternidad, pero ella se niega, alega que la niña vivió un trauma y por eso rechaza a los homosexuales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Pareja de un circo; Terapia de mordiscos
programme.desc: Rafael y Samanta son una pareja de acróbatas, ella quiere aceptar un nuevo trabajo, pero él no. Mariana inventa una terapia contra la eyaculación precoz usando mordiscos, ahora la acosan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Rosalba prohíbe la entrada de homosexuales a su restaurante, su hijo la demanda, no comparte sus ideas. Luis exige que Andrea interne a su hijo autista para protegerla, ella pide el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Juego de rol; Hija de mi hermano
programme.desc: Victoria fue víctima de un juego de roles, su boda y su marido son falsos, la usaron para grabar un video. Johana exige que su cuñado asuma la paternidad de su bebé, la esposa de él se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paco demanda a su expareja por plagio, alega que le robó una aplicación para encuentros de tríos. Bruno exige que su esposa Helena desaloje a su familia y a su ex, que los trajo sin avisarle.

programme.title: Caso Cerrado
programme.desc: Miembros de la iglesia católica debatirán los asuntos actuales que han surgido en los medios desde la controversia del Padre Alberto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Marido fluffer; Hija enferma de otro
programme.desc: El trabajo de Juan es calentar a los actores porno antes de grabar; su esposa quiere el divorcio. Andrés descubre que su hija es fruto de una infidelidad; quiere dejar a su esposa y a la niña.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Que esposa regrese a Venezuela; Hijo sugiere eutanasia para mamá
programme.desc: Yudi abandona a su familia para ganar una competencia, su esposo le exige que se ocupe del niño. Loreta demanda a su esposa porque quiere someterse a un suicidio asistido e involucra a su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niño con bola en cuello falsa; Adopción gay
programme.desc: Julio quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo, la madre usa al niño para recaudar dinero en internet. Pablo e Iñaki contratan a una madre subrogada, ahora se divorcian y no saben qué hacer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El hombre con la cabeza atrás; Fotos con orgasmos
programme.desc: Yenni exige la aprobación de su esposo para dar en adopción a su hija que tiene una grave malformación. Pedro demanda a su empleadora, quien lo incitó a masturbarse ante la cámara y luego lo despidió.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Maestros armados; Gemelas de 17 casarse con tercero
programme.desc: Marlene aprueba que los maestros porten armas, su esposo no, ella quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hija. Sasha pide la emancipación de sus gemelas, alega que ya no puede controlarlas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niña pintora, padre abusador; ¿Qué hacemos con María desnuda?
programme.desc: Melissa es pintora y tiene nueve años, afirma que su padre la explota, quiere vivir con su abuela. Ana pide que sus cuñados se ocupen de su suegra, perdió la razón y ella no puede cuidarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Me casé con suegro x papeles; Bebé muere asfixiada
programme.desc: Ana se casó con Juan, su suegro, para obtener la residencia. Además, una bebé murió ahogada por su hermana mayor. La madre culpa al padre porque, mientras ocurría la tragedia, el hombre estaba teniendo sexo con la niñera que debía cuidar a las niñas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Asilo de viejos gozando; Beba no quiere medula de mamá
programme.desc: Ana Lola es dueña de un asilo de ancianos donde los residentes tienen sexo unos con otros. Beba necesita un trasplante de médula ósea para sobrevivir, pero no quiere a su madre como donante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mata puercos; Adicta a ser bebé
programme.desc: En casa de Yamileth inician un negocio ilegal de matar cerdos, teme que arresten a toda la familia. Laura es una mujer adulta con una extraña adicción: vivir como un bebé varias horas al día.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sangre de rata rejuvenece; Hijastros con sida
programme.desc: Ángela crea un tratamiento para rejuvenecer y el principal ingrediente es sangre de ratas; su arrendador la demanda. David demanda a su esposa; descubrió que los gemelos que adoptó tienen sida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Odio a papá por poner cuernos; Whatsapp dudoso testigo
programme.desc: Carla no soporta que su padre le fuera infiel a su madre, le exige que deje la casa y se divorcie. Nataly demanda a su hermana por acusarla falsamente de acoso sexual; quiere 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.desc: Phoenix, Arizona wasn't supposed to be the city we know in present day. Before Area 51, hidden deep in the desert, the military discovered a hidden gem that helped them cover up the UFO wave of 1947. Roswell was not the only event that took place. Arizona was home to three major UFO events that the public hardly knows about. These events helped create Project Bluebook.

programme.title: Psychic Witness

Desperate for answers, the victim's father consults psychic Gale St. John, who leads police to the girl's body - and warns that the killer will strike the roommate next. On a rural road in Louisiana, a motorist discovers the mangled body of a 16-year-old boy. Police first believe it's a hit and run - but then suspect murder. They call on psychic Rosemarie Kerr to help them find the truth - but the truth is almost too much to bear.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode, Sandra McLemore invites you to experience Austria like never before—through its royal palaces, charming villages, and centuries-old traditions. Wander through Schönbrunn Palace after hours, uncovering secret passageways, regal ballrooms, and stories of Empress Sisi. Then, watch a master pastry chef craft the perfect apple strudel—Vienna’s most iconic dessert. The journey continues to Dürnstein, a fairytale village in the Wachau Valley, where apricot orchards, wine, and UNESCO charm steal the spotlight. And in Hallstatt, go underground for an epic adventure through the world’s oldest working salt mine—slides, miner’s gear, and all. Along the way, Sandra shares must-know travel tips for making the most of your Austrian escape. From imperial elegance to alpine thrills, this episode blends history, culture, and flavor into one unforgettable journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Sustainability and Sport in the Jungle
programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Return to The Amazon-The Chief's Blessing
programme.desc: Two years after his first Amazon expedition, Jeff Fuchs is invited back by his friend Juan Alan Muñoz for an extraordinary journey into one of the most remote and untouched parts of the rainforest. After arriving by cargo plane in the outpost of La Chorrera, Jeff boards Juan’s newly outfitted hospital boat—but before the journey can begin, he is summoned to meet the regional Chief of the Igara Paraná. In a powerful exchange of trust and tradition, Jeff offers gifts of maple syrup and receives the Chief’s blessing to travel the sacred waterways.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Shadows of the Rubber Boom
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Providencia & the Wisdom of the Bora
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff is finally summoned to the Maloka—the ceremonial longhouse—by the Chief of the Bora people. In a moment of deep cultural significance, the Chief offers his blessing and invites Jeff to witness a traditional gathering of the entire village and visiting Amazonian leaders. As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. It's a rare and intimate glimpse into the heart of Indigenous ceremony in the Amazon.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbol of identity, respect, and connection to the land.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As Jeff’s journey along the Igara Paraná draws to a close, the hospital boat enters the Putumayo River—edging ever closer to the self-isolated Pupuna tribe. The first stop along this new stretch is Puerto Arica, a lively river town hosting an international soccer tournament that brings together traders, travelers, and communities from across the Amazon. Amid the weekend of celebration, Jeff is invited on a night-time caiman hunt beneath a moonlit sky, and joins a local tradesman for an early morning fishing trip followed by a rustic riverside breakfast. It’s a brief but colorful pause before the journey continues deeper into isolation.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: While anchored for an overnight stay along the Putumayo River, Jeff and the crew are approached by a group of Israelites—members of a little-known, non-Indigenous community that has settled deep in the Amazon to prepare for a prophesied seven-year drought. What begins as a surreal encounter takes an unexpected turn when the group requests medical help for the ailing grandson of their community leader. This urgent plea grants Jeff and the team unprecedented access to a secretive world rarely seen by outsiders—revealing a unique blend of spiritual belief, isolation, and survivalist purpose hidden deep within the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - The Encounter with the Pupuna
programme.desc: After weeks navigating remote rivers, dense jungle, and unexpected encounters, Jeff and the floating hospital team finally reach their most distant and mysterious destination: the territory of the self-isolated Pupuna. What follows is a delicate and respectful moment of contact, made possible only through trust built over years and the careful guidance of local leaders. With no cameras allowed beyond a certain point, Jeff experiences a rare glimpse into a community untouched by modern influence—where ancient ways of life endure in harmony with the forest. It is a quiet, humbling encounter that marks the emotional peak of the Amazon journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the season finale of It’s a Beautiful World, Jeff looks back on the unforgettable meals and spontaneous encounters and places that shaped his journey through the Amazon. This episode captures the emotional heart of the expedition.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Teen Girl Obsessed With Her Ex
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Marriage, work, motherhood and stress can take a toll on your health, as well as your looks. Actress and author Lisa Rinna joins The Doctors to lend insight on how to get your sexy back, and look and feel your best at any age!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Milk, eggs, medicine and sneakers all have one thing in common: limited shelf lives. But do you really need to toss them by a certain date? THE DOCTORS reveal when something is safe to keep and when you should throw it away! Do you know what lurks in your mattress and linens? See the shocking results one couple receives, and learn how to keep your bed clean and safe. You don’t always need an expiration date to tell you when food has gone bad. Learn a simple trick to identify a good egg from a bad egg. And, leftovers don’t come with an “eat-by” date. THE DOCTORS explain when your leftovers should head to the trash can. Do you have a hard time parting with comfortable old shoes? Find out the shelf life for your sneakers, and see why you might want to toss out your old kicks.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors “Race to Erase 10 Years” on a lucky audience member! Just wait until you see The jaw-dropping results! Candle explosion: could it happen to you? People are suing The major cereal companies over “nutritious” and “wholesome” claims! Guest loses 170 pounds but it isn’t enough! Find out what still is weighing her down. The Doctors discusses a new study that claims going vegan leads to depression! Product claims to whiten teeth 6 shades lighter in just 3 days? Does it work or is it 50 shades of disappointment? We’re putting it to The test! Plus, The water bottle danger you haven’t heard!

programme.title: The Doctors

programme.title: The Lawnmower Man (Theatrical Cut) (1992)
programme.desc: Dr. Lawrence Angelo (Pierce Brosnan) is a brilliant scientist obsessed with perfecting virtual reality software. When his experiments on animals fail, he finds the ideal substitute – Jobe Smith (Jeff Fahey), a slow-witted gardener. Dr. Angelo's goal is to benefit his human guinea pig and ultimately mankind itself, but evil lurks the guise of "the Shop," a shadowy group that seeks to use the technology to create an invincible war machine. When the experiments change the simple Jobe into a superhuman being, the stage is set for a Jekyll-and-Hyde struggle for the control of Jobe's mind and the future of the world.

programme.title: 10th And Wolf (2006)

programme.title: The Road To Wellville (1994)
programme.desc: Presiding over the renowned Battle Creek Sanitarium is the visionary cornflake inventor and health-craze huckster Dr. John Harvey Kellogg (Hopkins). Seeking to improve their health – and their marriage – are Eleanor (Fonda), Kellogg's spellbound devotee, and Will (Broderick), her reluctant but devoted husband. What doesn't kill them in this spa/hospital/grand hotel will only make them stronger as they make their way through an obstacle course of sexual temptations, mechanical contraptions and dietary breakthroughs. Filled with outrageous methodology and hilarious hijinks, this "sumptuously photographed turn-of-the-century comedy with a fine cast" (San Francisco Chronicle) will make you double over ... with laughter!

programme.desc: The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.
